name: Lauki Kofta Curry
ingredients: 250 g lauki (bottle gourd), grated and squeezed dry
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
2 tomatoes and 1 onion, blended into a paste
½ tsp each cumin, coriander powder and garam masala
steps: Mix the lauki, besan, chilli, ginger, ajwain and salt into a firm dough. Shape into 8 small balls.
Bake the koftas at 200°C for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and firm.
Heat the oil and cook the tomato-onion paste with garlic and spices for 10 minutes until the oil separates.
Add 1½ cups water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the koftas just before serving and warm for 2 minutes. Finish with garam masala and coriander.
note: Baked rather than deep-fried koftas keep the fat low. Squeeze the lauki well or the koftas will fall apart.
